item.title: Make-A-Wish grants 8-year-old's dream trip
item.description: Born with congenital heart disease, Kyleigh has already endured five open-heart surgeries. Last year, doctors performed a 20-hour operation to repair her heart and lungs, a procedure that tested her strength and her family's faith.

item.title: Rain could shift outdoor plans for Valentine's Day
item.description: Rain could put a damper on some Valentine’s Day plans this year, especially for couples hoping to celebrate outdoors.

item.title: Missouri approves new Ameren gas plant and battery site in Jefferson County
item.description: Missouri regulators approved a plan to build a new natural gas plant and battery storage facility in Jefferson County on the site of the retired Rush Island coal plant.

item.title: Josh Hawley, Elizabeth Warren team up to crack down on 'Big Medicine'
item.description: Two unlikely allies - Missouri U.S. Sen. Josh Hawley (R) and Massachusetts U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D) - have teamed up to introduce the "Break Up Big Medicine Act."

item.title: FBI gives description of masked suspect at Nancy Guthrie home, ups reward
item.description: Authorities have also asked those in the area for video footage going back to Jan. 1.

item.title: Check out this $1.7 million 'unicorn mansion' in Ballwin
item.description: Positioned high above Castlewood State Park, a tall modern home tucked at the end of a Ballwin subdivision is hitting the market with a $1.69 million price tag, and plenty of room for imagination.

item.title: Missouri bill could fast-track downtown St. Louis redevelopment
item.description: Missouri lawmakers are considering a bill that could reshape downtown St. Louis through major tax incentives aimed at turning vacant office buildings into new homes and businesses.

item.title: St. Louis smoke shop sued over unregulated THC-infused snacks
item.description: A new lawsuit accuses a south St. Louis smoke shop of selling unregulated THC-infused candies and snacks that mimic popular name brands and are described as "intoxicating" edibles.

item.title: Skating coach mourned after drive-thru shooting
item.description: The Metro Edge Figure Skating Club is mourning the loss of coach Sam Linehan, who was shot and killed Tuesday morning while stopping at a Starbucks drive-thru on South Grand in St. Louis.

item.title: St. Louis firefighters fought City Hall and won
item.description: Dozens of St. Louis firefighter promotions in January were the first the department has been able push through in years.
